plotagents

Beautiful charts from one JSON spec. Data and field names go in; an accessible SVG comes out, with careful typography, colorblind-safe colors and tooltips. Built so an AI agent can chart anything without thinking about design: 26 chart types, seaborn's included, time sliders, small multiples and JSON themes.

npm install plotagents
CompareTimePart-to-wholeMapsDistributionsRelationshipsNetworks and flowsFlows and numbersConfiguration

Compare 5

Columns

Few short categories become columns, sorted largest first, with the value on each tip and no axis, since the values are already written.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "Biobío concentra el 30% de las ventas del sur",
  subtitle: "Ventas por región, millones de pesos, 2025",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", ventas: 1240},
    {region: "Araucanía", ventas: 880},
    // … 4 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "ventas"
})

Horizontal bars with highlight

Long labels switch to horizontal bars automatically. highlight emphasizes one category and mutes the rest.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "Casi tres de cada diez reclamos son por retrasos en la entrega",
  subtitle: "Reclamos recibidos por motivo, enero a junio",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {servicio: "Retraso en la entrega del pedido", casos: 412},
    {servicio: "Cobro duplicado en la tarjeta", casos: 268},
    // … 5 filas más
  ],
  x: "servicio",
  y: "casos",
  highlight: "Retraso en la entrega del pedido"
})

Grouped bars

One color per series, in fixed order. With two or more series the legend is always there.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "En 2025 el canal online superó por primera vez a la tienda",
  subtitle: "Ventas por canal, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2022, canal: "Tienda", ventas: 820},
    {"año":2022, canal: "Online", ventas: 310},
    // … 10 filas más
  ],
  x: "año",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "canal"
})

100% stacked

stack: "percent" compares composition. Shares are written inside a segment only when they fit.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "En Biobío casi 4 de cada 10 pesos se venden online",
  subtitle: "Participación de cada canal en las ventas regionales",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Tienda", ventas: 520},
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Online", ventas: 480},
    // … 13 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "canal",
  stack: "percent",
  horizontal: true
})

Countplot

type: "countplot" counts rows per category, no pre-aggregation needed.

Show code
plot({
  type: "countplot",
  title: "Concepción concentra 60 de 192 respuestas",
  subtitle: "Respuestas de la encuesta por sede",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sede: "Concepción", canal: "Teléfono", nota: 7},
    {sede: "Concepción", canal: "Presencial", nota: 4.405015014597343},
    // … 190 filas más
  ],
  x: "sede"
})

Time 8

Lines with an annotation

Labels always sit at the end of each line; when they collide they are spread apart with a leader line. In the browser a slider narrows the period.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Ñuble acelera desde la apertura de su nueva sucursal",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales por región, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  annotations: [
    {
      x: "2024-01",
      label: "Nueva sucursal en Chillán"
    }
  ]
})

Index = 100 (no dual axis)

Measures on different scales never share two axes: index: true rebases them to 100 so growth can be compared.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Los clientes crecieron 2,4 veces; la dotación, solo 7%",
  subtitle: "Índice 2018 = 100",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2018, ingresos: 1180, dotacion: 212, clientes: 3100},
    {"año":2019, ingresos: 1260, dotacion: 220, clientes: 3400},
    // … 6 filas más
  ],
  x: "año",
  y: [
    "clientes",
    "ingresos",
    "dotacion"
  ],
  labelsFor: {
    dotacion: "Dotación"
  },
  index: true,
  refLines: [
    {
      y: 100,
      label: "Base"
    }
  ]
})

Area with a target

One hue at 12% opacity and a reference line for a target, average or threshold.

Show code
plot({
  type: "area",
  title: "El saldo de caja superó la meta en enero de 2025",
  subtitle: "Saldo de caja a fin de mes, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2024-01", saldo: 420},
    {mes: "2024-02", saldo: 457},
    // … 22 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "saldo",
  refLines: [
    {
      y: 600,
      label: "Meta"
    }
  ]
})

100% stacked areas

stack: "percent" shows how each region's share of the total changes over time; labels at the end give the latest share. curve: "smooth" never invents peaks.

Show code
plot({
  type: "area",
  title: "Ñuble pasó de 19% a 27% de las ventas del sur entre 2022 y 2025",
  subtitle: "Participación mensual de cada región en las ventas, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  stack: "percent",
  curve: "smooth"
})

Period with play (d3plus-style)

time: "año" shows one year at a time with a slider and a play button; every tile shows its change vs the previous year. Colors follow each sector across years. slider: false removes the slider, play: false only the button.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  title: "El cobre bajó de 67% a 55% de las exportaciones",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones por sector y producto, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Cobre", valor: 68.65},
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Litio", valor: 1.33},
    // … 158 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor",
  time: "año"
})

Treemap colored by change

With time, every tile shows its share and its change vs the previous period; colorBy: "change" paints growth in the cool hue and decline in the warm one.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  title: "El litio y las cerezas crecen más rápido que el resto",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones por sector y producto, variación anual",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Cobre", valor: 68.65},
    {"año":2018, sector: "Minería", producto: "Litio", valor: 1.33},
    // … 158 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor",
  time: "año",
  colorBy: "change"
})

Small multiples (facet)

facet: "region" draws one panel per region on the same scale with the same colors (seaborn col / col_wrap). Better than tangled lines.

Show code
plot({
  type: "area",
  title: "Las tres regiones crecen, Ñuble desde una base menor",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  facet: "region",
  columns: 3
})

Log scale

yScale: "log": exponential growth looks straight, so rates can be compared instead of levels. 1-2-5 ticks, no empty decades.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Los usuarios de la app se multiplicaron por 176 en cuatro años",
  subtitle: "Usuarios activos mensuales, escala logarítmica",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", plataforma: "App móvil", usuarios: 604},
    {mes: "2022-01", plataforma: "Sitio web", usuarios: 5581},
    // … 94 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "usuarios",
  series: "plataforma",
  yScale: "log"
})

Part-to-whole 6

Three-level treemap

Sector › subsector › product with path. Areas are exact (no header bands), one solid color per sector, wider gaps between sectors than inside them, and a legend with each sector's share. Hover the legend to light up a sector.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  title: "El cobre por sí solo explica el 54% de las exportaciones",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones por sector, subsector y producto, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Cobre", valor: 50.1},
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Molibdeno", valor: 3.1},
    // … 23 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "subsector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor"
})

Treemap with focus (drill-down)

focus: ["Agro"] shows only that branch, keeping its colors, with breadcrumbs to go back. In the browser, a click on a group does the same.

Show code
plot({
  type: "treemap",
  title: "Dentro del agro, la fruta fresca suma el 73%",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones agropecuarias por subsector y producto, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Cobre", valor: 50.1},
    {sector: "Minería", subsector: "Metálica", producto: "Molibdeno", valor: 3.1},
    // … 23 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "sector",
    "subsector",
    "producto"
  ],
  value: "valor",
  focus: [
    "Agro"
  ]
})

Sunburst

The same hierarchy as rings: the inner ring is level 1 and outer rings inherit its color. Total in the center. Click to drill in.

Show code
plot({
  type: "sunburst",
  title: "Docencia concentra el 49% del presupuesto",
  subtitle: "Presupuesto por área, unidad e ítem, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {area: "Docencia", unidad: "Pregrado", item: "Remuneraciones", monto: 2100},
    {area: "Docencia", unidad: "Pregrado", item: "Operación", monto: 520},
    // … 17 filas más
  ],
  path: [
    "area",
    "unidad",
    "item"
  ],
  value: "monto",
  format: "currency"
})

Pie

Percentages inside each slice and a legend table beside it. Six parts at most.

    {fuente: "Hidroeléctrica", gwh: 27},
    {fuente: "Solar", gwh: 22},
    // … 4 filas más

Donut with outside labels

labels: "outside" puts name and percentage outside, with leader lines that never collide.

Show code
plot({

  title: "Docencia e investigación suman el 73% del presupuesto",

Half donut

half: true draws a semicircle with the total on the baseline. Good for simple shares in little height.

Show code
plot({
  type: "donut",
  half: true,
  title: "El canal online ya vende más que la tienda",
  subtitle: "Ventas 2025 por canal, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {canal: "Online", ventas: 780},
    {canal: "Tienda", ventas: 740},
    // … 1 filas más
  ],
  label: "canal",
  value: "ventas",
  format: "currency"
})

Maps 4

Chile choropleth

Regions matched by name, code or alias ("RM", "Biobio", "Aisén"). The map sits on the left and a north-to-south column shows name, bar and value.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "chile",
  title: "El sur austral tiene el menor desempleo: 3,8% en Magallanes",
  subtitle: "Tasa de desocupación por región, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Arica y Parinacota", tasa: 8.9},
    {region: "Tarapacá", tasa: 7.8},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  key: "region",
  value: "tasa",
  format: {
    suffix: "%",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Desocupación"
})

Diverging map

With midpoint: 0 the scale diverges: one color for gains, another for losses and a neutral gray near zero.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "chile",
  title: "10 de 16 regiones aumentaron su empleo en el año",
  subtitle: "Variación anual de ocupados, %",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Arica y Parinacota", variacion: -1.8},
    {region: "Tarapacá", variacion: 0.6},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  key: "region",
  value: "variacion",
  midpoint: 0,
  format: {
    suffix: "%",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Variación"
})

Proportional symbol map

For absolute amounts (people, money) the circle area is proportional to the value; coloring regions misleads when their sizes differ.

Show code
plot({
  type: "symbolmap",
  geo: "chile",
  title: "La Región Metropolitana concentra el 42% de los habitantes",
  subtitle: "Población por región",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Arica y Parinacota", habitantes: 253000},
    {region: "Tarapacá", habitantes: 391000},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  key: "region",
  value: "habitantes",
  format: "compact"
})

World map

Equal Earth projection (true areas). Countries by ISO-3 code, Spanish or English name. missing: "plain" leaves countries without data unhatched.

Show code
plot({
  type: "choropleth",
  geo: "world",
  title: "China compra el 51% del cobre exportado",
  subtitle: "Exportaciones de cobre por destino, miles de millones de US$",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {iso3: "CHN", valor: 26.1},
    {iso3: "JPN", valor: 4.6},
    // … 19 filas más
  ],
  key: "iso3",
  value: "valor",
  missing: "plain",
  labels: 4,
  format: {
    prefix: "US$",
    decimals: 1
  },
  legendTitle: "Miles de millones"
})

Distributions 14

Line with a confidence band

ci: true (seaborn lineplot): with several observations per x, it draws the mean and its 95% interval. errorbar: "sd" also works.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Entre semana la espera tiene dos peaks: 10:00 y 18:00",
  subtitle: "Minutos de espera promedio por hora, con intervalo de confianza de 95%",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {hora: 8, dia: "Laboral", minutos: 3.4348942318371343},
    {hora: 8, dia: "Fin de semana", minutos: 7.693086451248866},
    // … 648 filas más
  ],
  x: "hora",
  y: "minutos",
  series: "dia",
  ci: true,
  xLabel: "Hora del día"
})

Barplot with intervals

type: "barplot" (or ci: true): mean per category with error bars. The tooltip shows the interval.

Show code
plot({
  type: "barplot",
  title: "Concepción tiene la mejor nota de satisfacción: 5,5",
  subtitle: "Nota promedio (1 a 7) por sede y canal, intervalo de 95%",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {sede: "Concepción", canal: "Teléfono", nota: 7},
    {sede: "Concepción", canal: "Presencial", nota: 4.405015014597343},
    // … 190 filas más
  ],
  x: "sede",
  y: "nota",
  series: "canal",
  sort: "none"
})

Histogram with density

Nice bin widths from Freedman–Diaconis and a KDE curve on the same scale.

Show code
plot({
  type: "hist",
  title: "La mitad de las atenciones dura menos de 9,1 minutos",
  subtitle: "Duración de 600 atenciones presenciales, minutos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {minutos: 5.4},
    {minutos: 6.2},
    // … 598 filas más
  ],
  x: "minutos",
  kde: true,
  xLabel: "Minutos"
})

Overlapping histograms

hue splits groups; multiple: "layer" overlaps them with transparency. Also "stack", "dodge" and "fill".

Show code
plot({
  type: "hist",
  title: "Los estudiantes presenciales promedian 0,5 puntos más que los de modalidad en línea",
  subtitle: "Distribución de notas finales (escala 1,0 a 7,0)",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {modalidad: "Presencial", nota: 5.4},
    {modalidad: "Presencial", nota: 5.7},
    // … 598 filas más
  ],
  x: "nota",
  hue: "modalidad",
  binWidth: 0.25,
  stat: "percent",
  commonNorm: false,
  xLabel: "Nota final"
})

Density by group

Filled density curves, one per area, each named over its peak. xScale: "log" also works.

Show code
plot({
  type: "kde",
  title: "Tecnología tiene la mediana salarial más alta: $1.590.000",
  subtitle: "Distribución del sueldo bruto mensual por área, miles de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {area: "Operaciones", sueldo: 837},
    {area: "Operaciones", sueldo: 1121},
    // … 578 filas más
  ],
  x: "sueldo",
  hue: "area",
  format: {
    prefix: "$"
  },
  xLabel: "Sueldo (miles de $)"
})

Cumulative distribution

Answers "what share is below this value?" without choosing bin widths. The median is marked.

Show code
plot({
  type: "ecdf",
  title: "En Biobío el 80% de los despachos llega en 5,1 días o menos; en Araucanía, en 8,5",
  subtitle: "Días entre la compra y la entrega, por región",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", dias: 3.8},
    {region: "Biobío", dias: 4.6},
    // … 658 filas más
  ],
  x: "dias",
  hue: "region",
  xLabel: "Días de despacho"
})

Box plot

Median, quartiles and whiskers at 1.5 × IQR; outliers as hollow dots. Long labels switch to horizontal.

Show code
plot({
  type: "box",
  title: "En CESFAM Santa Sabina la espera mediana es de 48 minutos, la más alta de la comuna",
  subtitle: "Minutos de espera para atención, 70 pacientes por centro",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {centro: "CESFAM Lorenzo Arenas", minutos: 21},
    {centro: "CESFAM Lorenzo Arenas", minutos: 24},
    // … 348 filas más
  ],
  x: "centro",
  y: "minutos",
  highlight: "CESFAM Santa Sabina",
  xLabel: "Minutos de espera"
})

Split violin

Mirrored density (KDE) per group. With two hue levels and split: true, each half is a group; inside, the IQR and median.

Show code
plot({
  type: "violin",
  title: "En gerencia, el sector privado paga 23% más en la mediana",
  subtitle: "Sueldo bruto mensual, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {cargo: "Analista", sector: "Público", sueldo: 2.09},
    {cargo: "Analista", sector: "Público", sueldo: 1.26},
    // … 538 filas más
  ],
  x: "cargo",
  y: "sueldo",
  hue: "sector",
  split: true,
  yScale: "log",
  yLabel: "Millones de pesos (escala log)"
})

Strip plot

Every observation is a point with deterministic jitter; the bar marks the group mean.

Show code
plot({
  type: "strip",
  title: "La Sección 3 tiene el mejor promedio (5,4); en total aprueba el 89% del curso",
  subtitle: "Notas finales en escala de 1 a 7",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {seccion: "Sección 1", nota: 6},
    {seccion: "Sección 1", nota: 5},
    // … 178 filas más
  ],
  x: "seccion",
  y: "nota",
  mean: true,
  refLines: [
    {
      y: 4,
      label: "Aprobación"
    }
  ],
  yDomain: [
    1,
    7
  ],
  yLabel: "Nota"
})

Swarm plot

No overlaps: each point moves just enough to clear the others, so the shape shows the distribution.

Show code

  type: "swarm",
  title: "Biobío resuelve sus trámites en 36 días en la mediana, el más rápido",
  subtitle: "Días hábiles desde el ingreso hasta la resolución",

  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", dias: 31},
    {region: "Biobío", dias: 27},
    // … 218 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "dias",
  highlight: "Biobío",

})

Point estimate with intervals

Mean with a 95% confidence interval (Student t), joined across categories. Labels at the end of each series.

Show code

  type: "point",
  title: "Concepción sube de 5,4 a 5,6 en el año y Los Ángeles baja a 5,2",
  subtitle: "Satisfacción promedio (1 a 7) con intervalo de confianza del 95%",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {trimestre: "T1", sede: "Concepción", nota: 6.2},
    {trimestre: "T1", sede: "Concepción", nota: 7},
    // … 718 filas más
  ],
  x: "trimestre",
  y: "nota",
  hue: "sede",
  yLabel: "Satisfacción promedio"
})

Box plot on a log scale

Amounts spanning several orders of magnitude: xScale: "log" on the value axis, with the points over each box.

Show code
plot({
  type: "box",
  title: "La mediana de una licitación LP es unas 6.000 veces la de un trato directo",
  subtitle: "Montos adjudicados por modalidad de compra, pesos",

    {tipo: "Trato directo", monto: 13258},
    {tipo: "Trato directo", monto: 5504},
    // … 248 filas más
  ],
  x: "monto",
  y: "tipo",
  xScale: "log",
  points: true,
  format: "currency",
  xLabel: "Monto adjudicado (escala log)"

Population pyramid

Back-to-back bars from a central axis; age groups sit in the middle column, with no duplicated axes. Each side is named, with its share, in its own color.

Show code
plot({
  type: "pyramid",

Pyramid with a comparison

compare: 2002 draws the earlier year as a stepped outline over the bars, showing where the base narrowed and the top grew.

Show code
plot({
  type: "pyramid",
  title: "Los menores de 15 años pasaron de 25% a 15% de la población",
  subtitle: "Participación por sexo y tramo de edad, 2024 frente a 2002",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {"año":2002, edad: "0-4", sexo: "Hombres", personas: 682},
    {"año":2002, edad: "0-4", sexo: "Mujeres", personas: 671},
    // … 66 filas más
  ],
  age: "edad",
  sex: "sexo",
  value: "personas",
  compareField: "año",
  compare: 2002,
  percent: true,
  compareLabel: "2002"
})

Relationships 6

Bubbles with a trend

Size is area-proportional to population. Only the points that matter are labeled, plus a least-squares line with R².

Show code
plot({
  type: "bubble",
  title: "A mayor ingreso por persona, mayor uso de internet",
  subtitle: "PIB per cápita (miles de US$ PPA) y % de la población que usa internet",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {pais: "Chile", pib: 30.2, internet: 90.2, poblacion: 19.8, continente: "Sudamérica"},
    {pais: "Perú", pib: 16, internet: 75, poblacion: 34, continente: "Sudamérica"},
    // … 14 filas más
  ],
  x: "pib",
  y: "internet",
  size: "poblacion",
  series: "continente",
  label: "pais",
  labels: [
    "Chile",
    "Estados Unidos",
    "Brasil",
    "Alemania",
    "Bolivia",
    "México"
  ],
  xLabel: "PIB per cápita (miles US$)",
  yLabel: "Usuarios de internet (%)",
  trend: true
})

Regression with confidence band

Points, fitted line and a 95% band for the mean. annotate adds R² and n.

Show code
plot({
  type: "regplot",
  title: "Cada hora semanal de estudio se asocia a 0,26 puntos más en la nota",
  subtitle: "Horas de estudio semanales y nota final de 140 estudiantes",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {horas: 6.3, nota: 5.5},
    {horas: 3.3, nota: 4.8},
    // … 138 filas más
  ],
  x: "horas",
  y: "nota",
  annotate: true,
  xLabel: "Horas de estudio por semana",
  yLabel: "Nota final"
})

Regression on a log axis

logx: true fits y ~ log(x) and draws a log x axis. With hue, one fit per group named at its end.

Show code
plot({
  type: "regplot",
  title: "Duplicar el ingreso por persona se asocia a 2,3 años más de esperanza de vida",
  subtitle: "Ingreso per cápita (US$, escala log) y esperanza de vida al nacer, 72 países",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "América", ingreso: 30835, vida: 82.5},
    {region: "América", ingreso: 12679, vida: 84.1},
    // … 70 filas más
  ],
  x: "ingreso",
  y: "vida",
  hue: "region",
  logx: true,
  xFormat: {
    prefix: "US$"
  },
  xLabel: "Ingreso per cápita (escala log)",
  yLabel: "Años de vida"
})

Joint plot

Scatter with marginal histograms on top and right, on the same scales. kind: "reg" adds the fit.

Residuals

To check a fit: residuals should scatter around zero with no pattern. lowess shows the trend.

Show code

  subtitle: "Residuos de la nota sobre las horas de estudio",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",

    {horas: 3.3, nota: 4.8},
    // … 138 filas más

  x: "horas",
  y: "nota",
  lowess: true,
  xLabel: "Horas de estudio por semana"
})

Radar

Profiles on comparable axes (same 1–5 scale). Thin polygons with a soft fill; labels anchor by angle.

Collaboration network

Click a node: it glides to the center with its connections highlighted (click again or press Esc to go back). Deterministic force layout. Size = projects (weighted degree), color = kind of organization; the largest are labeled. highlight keeps one node and its neighbors in view.

Chord diagram

Each arc is a zone's total; each ribbon, the exchange between two zones (the tooltip splits both directions). Ribbons take the color of the zone that sends more.

Show code

  type: "chord",
  title: "Metropolitana y Centro intercambian más personas que cualquier otro par: 135.000",
  subtitle: "Cambios de residencia entre macrozonas en cinco años",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",

    {origen: "Norte Grande", destino: "Norte Chico", personas: 9000},
    {origen: "Norte Grande", destino: "Centro", personas: 6000},
    // … 28 filas más

  from: "origen",
  to: "destino",
  value: "personas"
})

Flow chart with swimlanes

Nodes and edges with a type (start, process, decision, end) and a lane per unit. Layout is automatic; decisions branch from the side and loops go around without crossing nodes.

Show code

Flows and numbers 2

Heatmap

A single-hue sequential ramp. Values are written in the cell when they fit, in white or ink depending on contrast.

Show code
plot({
  type: "heatmap",
  title: "Los lunes a mediodía se concentra la demanda de atención",
  subtitle: "Atenciones promedio por día y hora",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {dia: "Lun", hora: "08:00", atenciones: 93},
    {dia: "Lun", hora: "10:00", atenciones: 130},
    // … 47 filas más
  ],
  x: "hora",
  y: "dia",
  value: "atenciones"
})

Indicators (KPI)

When the story is a number, the number is the chart. Change with arrow and text, a sparkline and a target meter.

Show code
plot({
  type: "kpi",
  title: "El trimestre cierra con ventas 12% sobre el año anterior",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  items: [
    {label: "Ventas", value: 1250000000, format: "currency", delta: 0.124, period: "vs T3 2025", trend: [8.1,8.6,8.4,9.8,10.9,12.5]},
    {label: "Clientes activos", value: 8420, delta: -0.032, period: "vs T3 2025", trend: [9,8.9,8.7,8.6,8.5,8.4]},
    {label: "Costo por cliente", value: 18500, format: "currency", delta: -0.08, good: "down", period: "vs T3 2025"},
    {label: "Satisfacción (NPS)", value: 62, target: 70, delta: 0.05, period: "vs T3 2025"}
  ]
})

Configuration 3

Dark theme + highlight

theme: "noche" uses the same hues, re-stepped and validated for a dark surface. highlight mutes the rest.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  theme: "noche",
  title: "Ñuble creció 60% en dos años, el triple que Biobío",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales por región, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  highlight: "Ñuble"
})

Font and text scale

font: "Poppins" and textScale: 1.6 enlarge every text for a presentation and the layout is recomputed. configure({ font, textScale }) sets them for every chart.

Show code
plot({
  type: "line",
  title: "Ñuble crece más rápido que el resto del sur",
  subtitle: "Ventas mensuales, millones de pesos",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Biobío", ventas: 123},
    {mes: "2022-01", region: "Araucanía", ventas: 81},
    // … 142 filas más
  ],
  x: "mes",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "region",
  font: "Poppins",
  textScale: 1.6
})

Themes are JSON

Colors, type, line weight, radii and axes are one JSON object. palette takes a name ("okabe-ito", "tableau10", "udec") or a list of colors; validatePalette() checks it.

Show code
plot({
  type: "bar",
  title: "Biobío y Araucanía suman la mitad de las ventas del sur",
  subtitle: "Ventas por región y canal, 2025",
  source: "datos ilustrativos",
  data: [
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Tienda", ventas: 86},
    {region: "Biobío", canal: "Online", ventas: 58},
    // … 4 filas más
  ],
  x: "region",
  y: "ventas",
  series: "canal",
  stack: true,
  theme: {
    extends: "papel",
    categorical: "okabe-ito",
    surface: "#FFFFFF",
    type: {
      title: 22,
      titleWeight: 700
    },
    marks: {
      barRadius: 8,
      barMax: 44
    }
  }
})
All data in this gallery is illustrative. Chart text uses the default Spanish (Chile) locale; set locale: "en" for English formats. Hover for values, drag the time sliders, and click a treemap or sunburst group to drill down. The page follows your system's light or dark mode.
